product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Weston Wood & Metal Nesting Tables, Set of 2, Brown
product.description: Together or apart, these handsome wood and metal nesting tables will serve you well. Use side by side as coffee tables or as end tables on either side of a sofa or bed. Stored together, they're a great space-saving solution. Large table: 17.7"W x 11.8"D x 23.8"H; Small table: 11.8"W x 9.8"D x 21.9"H Solid fir wood top; metal frame with black finish Modern design with classic wood finish for a transitional look Use side by side as coffee tables, or as end tables No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
